CustomField.description: Developer name of the Salesforce EmailTemplate used by the Form_Submission_Send_Resume_Link autolaunched flow when a respondent clicks Email me a resume link. Resolved at send time via the submission's Form_Template relationship. Leave blank to fall back to the minimal inline body the package ships.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: DeveloperName of the Salesforce EmailTemplate to use when sending the respondent a resume link. Leave blank to use the package's minimal default body.
CustomField.label: Email Template Name (Resume Form)
